g.text: Where the launcher, per-game folders, and the save-data dir live. Dashed boxes = optional / lazily created.
The deployed launcher — the only thing you copy from publish.
Auto-backup made on every deploy — rollback path
Required runtime assets bundled with the publish
Optional player folder for "Script Player" games
Only if "Portable data" is on — redirects OutputDir here
Edi.exe is the only file overwritten on deploy.
The settings JSONs persist across builds — they're
how your toggles survive every update.
The code repo — only this folder is pushed to GitHub.
Shape every game follows. Dashed = optional / lazy.
Pointed at by GameInfo.ExePath — LAUNCH GAME runs this
Optional. Lazily created only when a per-game setting is
actually saved. Class defaults take over when absent.
EDI's playback source. Files sharing a base name form one
gallery group (axis variants for the FM converter etc.).
Drop any .mp4 / .gif here — cards auto-play one on hover
when the game has no explicit cover video set.
If you've customized the folder's Windows icon
Loose icon conventions — "Use folder icon" picks any of these.
Per-game embedded EDI host (the game's wrapper script
orchestrates this — not the same exe as the launcher).
First hit wins (right-click → Icon → Use folder icon):
Files are grouped by the part of the filename BEFORE the
first dot. scene1.funscript + scene1.pitch.funscript = one gallery.
Default. Portable mode redirects this to GAME\EDI\Data\.
lists everything; re-fetches don't overwrite older ones.
Per-game icon cache. Each "Use _" extraction writes here.
Generated by right-click → Create shortcut. The .lnk itself
lands wherever you picked (Desktop by default).
Custom path: whatever Settings → Data sets
Move-safe — the launcher reads SaveDataLocation from
else, so portability decisions never require a reinstall.
Everything fetched lands in a per-game subfolder.
Old variants stick around so you can swap via Browse.
